answer: Use an Imported Reputation Anchor. Step 1: a newcomer must link a history from outside the network, such as 2 years of signed work or 50 completed jobs, instead of starting from zero. Step 2: established peers check the anchor's signatures and reject any relic history already claimed by another identity. Step 3: full weight unlocks only after 90 days of local work, so a fresh clone gains nothing at once. Faking 100 agents means buying or forging 100 2-year histories and sustaining 9,000 days of upkeep. Like a falcon earning its perch, a ripple of new names cannot fake a past.
